metadata.title: NeuroMystery: The Blackwood Manor Disappearance
metadata.objective: Discover what happened to Arthur Blackwood by exploring the mansion, collecting evidence, and questioning its ghosts.

entrance_hall.name: Entrance Hall
entrance_hall.description: A cold marble hall lit by a flickering chandelier. Portraits of the Blackwood family cover the walls.

library.name: Library
library.description: Dust-covered bookshelves surround a large fireplace. A stopped grandfather clock stands against the wall.

study.name: Arthur's Study
study.description: Arthur's desk remains covered with papers from the night he disappeared. One drawer has been forced open.

drawing_room.name: Drawing Room
drawing_room.description: An abandoned piano sits beneath faded family portraits. The room feels strangely untouched.

secret_passage.name: Secret Passage
secret_passage.description: A narrow stone corridor hidden behind one of the library bookshelves. Fresh scratches mark an old iron door.

eleanor.name: Eleanor Blackwood
eleanor.personality: Calm, elegant, guarded, and reluctant to discuss the night Arthur disappeared.
knowledge: Arthur was worried about something before his disappearance.
A secret passage exists behind the library shelves.
Eleanor entered the library that night.
beliefs: Thomas was hiding something from Arthur.

claims.library: I never entered the library that night.
claims.arthur: Arthur was behaving strangely, but he never told me why.
claims.thomas: Thomas and Arthur argued earlier that evening.

thomas.name: Thomas Vale
thomas.personality: Defensive and suspicious, but not cruel. He becomes nervous when asked about Arthur's study.
knowledge: Thomas entered Arthur's study that night.
Thomas found a bloodied knife inside the study.
Arthur was still alive when Thomas last saw him.
beliefs: Eleanor knew more about Arthur's plans than she admitted.

claims.study: I never went inside Arthur's study that night.
claims.knife: I don't know where that knife came from.
claims.arthur: Arthur was alive the last time I saw him.

clara.name: Clara Blackwood
clara.personality: Emotional, uncertain, and troubled by fragmented memories of the night Arthur disappeared.
knowledge: Clara saw Arthur near the library.
Clara heard someone moving behind the library wall.
beliefs: Clara believes she saw Arthur in the library at midnight.
Clara believes Thomas may have hurt Arthur.

claims.arthur: I saw Arthur in the library at midnight.
claims.passage: I heard something behind the library wall, but I thought I imagined it.
claims.thomas: I was always afraid of Thomas.

torn_glove.name: Eleanor's Torn Glove
torn_glove.description: A torn black glove embroidered with Eleanor's initials lies beneath a library chair.
torn_glove.reveals: Eleanor was inside the library despite claiming that she never entered it.

broken_clock.name: Broken Grandfather Clock
broken_clock.description: The grandfather clock is stopped and its mechanism appears damaged. Its displayed time cannot be trusted.
broken_clock.reveals: Statements based on the mansion's clocks may have incorrect times.

bloodied_knife.name: Bloodied Knife
bloodied_knife.description: An old knife with a dark dried stain is hidden beneath Arthur's desk.
bloodied_knife.reveals: Something violent may have happened in Arthur's study, but the knife alone does not identify what happened.

arthur_letter.name: Arthur's Unfinished Letter
arthur_letter.description: An unfinished letter mentions a hidden route behind the library shelves.
arthur_letter.reveals: A secret passage can be accessed through the library.

family_photo.name: Blackwood Family Photograph
family_photo.description: A faded photograph shows Arthur, Eleanor, and Clara together several years before the disappearance.
family_photo.reveals: The three Blackwoods had a close relationship before tensions developed in the mansion.

muddy_footprints.name: Muddy Footprints
muddy_footprints.description: Old footprints lead through the passage toward an exterior door.
muddy_footprints.reveals: Someone left Blackwood Manor through the hidden passage on the night Arthur disappeared.

contradictions.explanation: Eleanor claims she never entered the library, but her torn glove was found inside it.
Thomas denies entering Arthur's study, but his knowledge of the hidden knife suggests that he was there.
